_readme: The artist collective. Names are real (pulled from the old site and its reviews); every specialty, bio, and booking link marked TODO_CONFIRM is my reconstruction and needs Brooklyn's sign-off. Each artist runs an independent book, so bookingUrl can point at that artist's own Vagaro page once you have the deep links.

members.name: Brooklyn Boris
members.bio: Fifteen years behind the lash bed, split between Southern California and Melbourne, Australia. Brooklyn opened Flirt in October 2019 and teaches the next generation of lash artists through Aviara Beauty Academy.
members.imageAlt: Brooklyn Boris, founder of Flirt Lash Lounge & Day Spa.
